name: Burslem Park Community Orchard
description: A traditional community orchard in the grounds of Burslem Park featuring heritage apple and pear trees, open for public picking in season.

name: Westport Lake Blackberries
description: Extensive blackberry brambles line the footpaths and margins of Westport Lake nature reserve, with good picking from late summer.

name: Incredible Edible Burslem Town Planters
short_description: Urban growing in the heart of Burslem.
description: Community planters around the town centre and market square growing herbs, kale, and salad leaves for all to help themselves.

name: Trentham Estate Wild Garlic
short_description: Woodland garlic along the valley floor.
description: Damp wooded sections of the Trentham Estate and river margins are rich with spring wild garlic, best before the bluebells fade.

name: Ford Green Nature Reserve Elderberries
description: Elder bushes are common along the hedgerows and scrub edges of Ford Green Hollow nature reserve, flowering in June and fruiting by September.

name: Hanley Park Rosehips and Haws
description: The wilder boundary hedges of Hanley Park contain abundant rosehips and hawthorn haws come autumn, ideal for syrups and jellies.

name: Longton Park Hazelnuts
short_description: Hazel thickets in the park copses.
description: Hazel shrubs in the wilder wooded corners of Longton Park produce a reliable autumn crop of hazelnuts, best gathered in October.

name: Berryhill Fields Blackberries
description: The open countryside and footpath margins of Berryhill Fields are dotted with productive blackberry bushes throughout late summer.

name: Incredible Edible Longton Street Planters
short_description: Community veg in the town centre.
description: Raised planters near the covered market feature seasonal vegetables and culinary herbs managed by local volunteers.

name: Trentham Gardens Sweet Chestnuts
description: Large sweet chestnut trees in the woodland walks bordering Trentham Gardens produce a generous crop of nuts each October.

name: Lyme Valley Sloes
short_description: Blackthorn hedges along the valley lanes.
description: Blackthorn scrub along the quiet lanes and field edges in the Lyme Valley west of the city is excellent for autumn sloe picking.

name: Fenton Park Wild Damson
short_description: Hedgerow damsons near the park edge.
description: Wild damson and bullace trees grow in the hedgerows bounding Fenton Park, providing a classic Staffordshire autumn fruit.

name: Silverdale Community Orchard
description: A small community orchard on the edge of Silverdale planted with local apple varieties and a perry pear, maintained by volunteers.

name: Norton Priory Meadow Sorrel and Mint
description: Patches of wild sorrel and watermint grow in the damp low-lying meadows and stream margins at the northern edge of Norton.

name: Meir Park Wild Plums
short_description: Scrubland plums on the estate margins.
description: Wild plum and cherry trees are scattered along the scrubby path margins and green corridors of Meir Park estate.
